title: Auronzo di Cadore Catalog V2 Fact Enrichment
summary: Reviews Monte Agudo and Auronzo di Cadore source-aware facts and graph scope against official municipal tourism and operator sources. Supported town character, settlement elevation, winter shuttle access, and the Taiarezze lift-base stay sector are added while unsupported ski-area facilities remain explicit.
